say:1:1430129401:1.text: We've been mining other ores since the beginning of time. It's just that the weapons made by echorite sold the best.
say:1:1430129401:1.source_cn: 其他矿石的挖掘没有停过……但之前销量最好的武器，可都是...

say:2:1430129402:1.text: Compared to echorite, ordinary weapons made with ordinary materials aren't going to sell. This is going to affect our wages big time!
say:2:1430129402:1.source_cn: 没了深晶岩制作的特殊武器，我们制作的普通武器很可能滞销...

say:3:1430129403:1.text: If this continues, I'll never save enough to open my own shop!
say:3:1430129403:1.source_cn: 这样下去，我什么时候才能存够开工坊的钱！
